verdict.rationale: GitBook ships built-in background agent behavior: GitBook Agent flags outdated content and drafts fixes, reviews change requests, and handles auto translations with minimal manual effort. The evidence describes these as fixed, vendor-defined agent features, not a general facility where users set up their own automations. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation triggers, schedules or workflows; detail on how autonomously the agent acts (e.g., whether it publishes or only drafts for review); independent or hands-on corroboration.
